text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: spike in 5xx + generation failures for model variant narwhal-v2-beta in us-east-1. 5xx rate up from 0.05% -> 7.1% in 5m. Affected endpoints: /v1/chat, /v1/generate-stream. Top keys: cust:zephyr, cust:acme. Paging @sahil (oncall).

sahil: oncall here, ack. Pulling runbook and last deploys. If noisy, will apply mitigations.

amanda: there was a canary push to narwhal-v2-beta ~90m ago (CI# 2026-1189). Metrics show tokenization errors and sporadic kernel timeouts. No infra OOMs. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/variant-failure

matt_k: Agree with soft-degrade then traffic shift to conservative variant narwhal-stable-1 while we triage. Also propose per-key rate slices for heavy keys.

sahil: doing soft-degrade now.

sahil: `redwoodctl variant set-concurrency narwhal-v2-beta --multiplier 0.45 --reason "emergency soft degrade due to 5xx spike"`

ops-bot: OK: concurrency multiplier applied to narwhal-v2-beta=0.45. Est throughput -45%. op-id=op-3824567001

amanda: starting staged reroute to narwhal-stable-1: 25% -> 50% -> 100% in 10m windows if errors fall.

amanda: `trafficctl reroute --from narwhal-v2-beta --to narwhal-stable-1 --percent 25 --strategy gradual --window 5m`

traffic-bot: In progress: rerouted 25% traffic to narwhal-stable-1. Monitoring errors and latency. cmd=tc-3824567012

jess: support note: cust:zephyr reporting partial streams and retries. Looping in SEs and prepping customer comms. Will draft in ~8m.

matt_k: applying temporary quota slices for the top offending keys to reduce pressure.

matt_k: `quotactl slice --prefix cust:zephyr --rate 0.4rps --duration 45m --reason "backpressure mitigation"`

quota-bot: Applied slices: cust:zephyr=0.4rps, cust:acme=0.3rps. slice-id=qc-3824567040

amanda: after 12m monitoring: narwhal-v2-beta 5xx down from 7.1% -> 1.5% with 25% reroute + degrade. Streaming tail latency still elevated for high-concurrency sessions.

sahil: partial improvement but still visible customer impact. Recommend full swap to narwhal-stable-1 across regions and drain v2-beta. Any objections?

laura: no objections. Opening incident INC-2026-402 and escalating to product/security for awareness.

laura: `ticket create --title "INC: narwhal-v2-beta elevated 5xx -> swap to stable" --severity P1 --link https://incidents/INC-2026-402`

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-402 created and linked. Notifications sent to product@ and security@.

amanda: performing immediate full swap and drain.

amanda: `trafficctl reroute --from narwhal-v2-beta --to narwhal-stable-1 --percent 100 --strategy immediate --drain 45s`

traffic-bot: OK: 100% traffic now on narwhal-stable-1. narwhal-v2-beta draining. cmd=tc-3824567077 :white_check_mark:

sahil: monitoring customer-facing metrics: global 5xx now ~0.18%, streaming success back to baseline. Good signs.

jess: shared customer comms draft in #support-drafts and alerted account teams. SEs starting outreach to cust:zephyr and cust:acme.

matt_k: capturing kernel + tokenizer traces and saving failing request corpus to s3: s3://telemetry/narwhal/v2-beta/fails/3824567055.log

sahil: handing off the oncall in 30m. Mitigation checklist in incident ticket: 1) keep v2-beta drained, 2) maintain quota slices for 60m, 3) collect traces and model artifacts, 4) coordinate rollback vs hotfix PR with ML infra. Escalate if >0.5% 5xx recurs.

laura: postmortem owner assigned: amanda. Please include timeline, why canary penetrated, and how routing/quotas performed. Schedule blameless postmortem in 48h.

jess: note for re-enable: only staged canary with telemetry gates and auto-rollback if >0.5% 5xx sustained over 5m.

sahil: closing active mitigation loop; leaving thread open for follow-ups. :lock:
